resolvedAttempts.name: focused-1802
resolvedAttempts.reason: Four initial failures were fixtures: Light vanilla dm01-075 is not a blocker, so Jiek evolution/decline fixtures now use the actual Light blocker dm01-076. The Aura/GR fixture now has the actual hasAuras1352 initialization flag and advance format, as set by native Aura play. All 57 final focused assertions pass, including GR later returning home when paid as a physical Meteor source. New ordering test exposed an accidental edit duplicated into heuristic scoring and an incorrect projectRoom test argument. Removed the scoring mutation, added AI purity assertion, and corrected user object/game.actions access before final checks.
